Orbital for Mac, Windows and Linux. Everything stays on your computer in Orbital's own private database.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple chip (M1–M4) | `Orbital-0.3.9-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel chip | `Orbital-0.3.9.dmg` |
| Windows | `Orbital-Setup-0.3.9.exe` |
| Linux | `Orbital-0.3.9.AppImage` or `orbital_0.3.9_amd64.deb` |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu → About This Mac → "Chip".

## First launch

These early builds aren't signed with a paid Apple/Microsoft certificate yet, so your computer asks once:

- **Mac:** open the .dmg and drag Orbital to Applications. The first time, **right-click Orbital → Open → Open**
  (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway").
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

## AI is optional

Orbital works without an AI key: notes, Papers, projects, search, reminders, focus and meetings all work, and
questions are answered from your own knowledge. For AI chat, research and writing help, add your own key in
**Settings → AI & research**. It stays on your computer.

## What's new in 0.3.9

- **Orbital Pro.** Every feature is free for 14 days. After that, the core of Orbital stays free forever, and Pro ($10/month or $96/year) unlocks deep research, meetings and recordings, the Media library, opportunity discovery, automations and knowledge health scans. Everything you've made stays yours either way. See Settings → Plan.

New in 0.3.8:

- **Forgot your password? Reset it right in the app.** Everything is on your computer, so no email is needed.
- **A new install opens on "Create your Orbital"** instead of "Welcome back".
- **Clearer AI setup:** chat tells you where to add your AI key, and Settings → AI & research has the key box with 3 simple steps to get one.
- **Fixes:** the Focus page layout, a wrong "notifications are blocked" note on the Reminders page, the waitlist link and "this server" wording on the sign-in screen, and the orb not filling its space on computers without 3D graphics.

New in 0.3.7:

- **Voice now works in the desktop app:** talk to Orbital, dictate in Papers, and turn recordings in Media into text. Speech recognition runs privately on your computer. The first time, it downloads a speech model once (about 80 MB); after that it works offline.

New in 0.3.6:

- **Reminders keep working with the window closed:** Orbital stays in the menu bar (Mac) or system tray (Windows) and shows a system notification when a reminder is due. The Dock/taskbar icon shows how many are due. You can also have Orbital open when you log in (Settings → Desktop).
- **Repeating reminders:** every day, every weekday, chosen days, every few weeks, monthly or yearly, with an optional end date.
- **Just type it:** "call Sam friday at 3", "pay rent every month on the 1st", "standup every weekday at 9:30". Works on the Reminders page, in chat ("remind me to…", typed or spoken) and in ⌘K, with no AI key needed.

New in 0.3.5:

- **Media:** one place for screenshots, screen recordings, voice notes, camera recordings, uploads and meeting playbacks. Record right inside Orbital, watch or listen back, search, rename, download, and turn recordings into text.
- **Record meetings:** the record button saves everyone's video and sound; everyone in the meeting can see when it's being recorded.

Also new since 0.3.3:

- **Dashboards:** build your own home page from 18 widgets (tasks, projects, reminders, notes, research, focus, activity, growth, recently viewed, favorites and more). Add, resize, rearrange; keep several dashboards; start from templates.
- **Your environment:** choose what Orbital opens to, reorder or hide sidebar sections, and pick an accent colour, Neural Core colours, a background and text size (Settings → Your environment).
- **Clock and weather** in the sidebar. Weather finds your city from your time zone automatically, or use your exact location, or type any place.
- **Recently viewed:** the last 10 things you opened, in the sidebar and the command palette.
- **Favorites:** star any page, note, paper, conversation or project to pin it in the sidebar.
- **Cards glow** softly when you hover them.
- Plus everything from 0.3.3: light and dark themes, the smoother intro, the new wordmark.
